title: Plan 4 drafted from roadmap v1.1
body: Drafted Plan 4 per docs/roadmap-2026-05-19-install-ux-architecture-v0.md (v1.1). 5-feature shape: F001 CLI + crawler + JSON (independently shippable foundation), F002 HTML renderer, F003 doctor drift probe, F004 supervisor regen-to-working-tree (no auto-commit), F005 opt-in pre-commit hook (warn-only default). Operator review constraints baked in: architecture.json tracked / architecture.html gitignored; supervisor never auto-commits; pre-commit hook defaults to warn + print regen command (no mutation); first consumer is Plan 4.5's dontpanic new with graceful fallback when map is absent or stale.

body: Plan reviewed; features.json validates; allowed_paths covers architecture.py + supervisor + doctor + tests + docs/architecture/ + .gitignore. Forbidden_decisions explicit on no-auto-commit + gitignored HTML + working-tree-only regen + no test regressions. Sanitization clean. title: F001 close-out: stopped_no_progress (fingerprint scope defect patched)
body: Plan 4 F001 terminated stopped_no_progress after 2 rounds. iter0+iter1 implementer both signed_off (8.6M in / 70K out) but iter1 auditor caught a real correctness gap: source_fingerprint excluded claude/shared/VERSION even though the snapshot consumes it per-schema entry. Hand-patched in this commit: architecture._fingerprint_files() now appends self.roots.version_file before the plans extension. A VERSION bump now triggers stale_minor drift classification as required. Local sweep: 1956 passed (27 new architecture tests included). Other findings: none of substance. Operator-resolved as implementation_defect_patched.

title: F002 close-out: stopped_no_progress (2 substantive findings hand-patched)
body: Plan 4 F002 terminated stopped_no_progress after 2 rounds. iter0+iter1 implementer signed_off; iter1 auditor surfaced two real implementation_defect findings + one environmental, both real ones hand-patched in this commit: (1) high/correctness — `architecture_html.py` did not validate the snapshot dict's typed fields against `architecture-snapshot.schema.json` before rendering. Fix tightens `_validate_snapshot_shape` to reject non-int `source_fingerprint.files_count` and non-string `source_fingerprint.file_hashes_root` with helpful ArchitectureRenderError + regen pointer. (2) medium/security — when files_count was a non-int (e.g., `"<script>x</script>"`), the renderer's fallback at line 272 interpolated it raw, allowing HTML injection. Fix at architecture_html.py:_render_header now always html.escape()s the fallback branch; validator rejection above is the primary defense. (3) high/test_coverage — auditor sandbox couldn't write temp dir for pytest; operator verified full sweep locally (2011 passed, 7 skipped) — classified environmental_reproduction_failure. Added 4 regression tests in test_architecture_html_f002.py (b6/b7/b8 validator + b9 escape fallback). Sanitization clean (1278 files scanned). Operator-resolved as implementation_defect_patched.

title: F005 close-out: signed_off iter0 (advisory perf-test rename hand-patched)
body: Plan 4 F005 dispatched in parallel with F003, signed_off on iter0 (1 round), paused on pre_merge gate. Implementer added scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/architecture_hook.py + scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_architecture_hook_f005.py + architecture status / architecture hook --install / --uninstall subcommands on the CLI. Codex auditor signed_off with one advisory/test_coverage finding: test_e_hook_is_fast_under_one_second asserts <5.0s (not <1.0s as the name suggests). Implementer's comment explicitly justifies the 5s wall-clock budget for CI Python interpreter startup variance (real hook measured 0.25s in dev). Renamed function to test_e_hook_commit_overhead_under_five_seconds to align name with budget; semantics preserved. Concurrent F003+F005 dispatch surfaced a v5 carry candidate: supervisor-registry re-entrancy WARNING fired (pid=39477 already active on same plan_id) but volleys completed cleanly. No audit interleave observed in practice. Operator-resolved as implementation_defect_patched (advisory-class rename).

title: F003 close-out: stopped_no_progress (spec_ambiguity on flag naming)
body: Plan 4 F003 terminated stopped_no_progress after 2 rounds. iter0+iter1 implementer signed_off; iter1 auditor surfaced one medium/correctness finding classifying it as implementation_defect — but the actual issue is spec_ambiguity: the features.json spec says `--strict` blocks on stale_major/ABSENT, but the implementer wired `--architecture-drift-strict` because a plain `--strict` flag would either collide with the existing `--strict-codes` flag or get accepted as an argparse abbreviation for it (auditor's own evidence confirms: 'Running --strict on the script is accepted as an argparse abbreviation for --strict-codes'). The implementer's namespaced flag is the right engineering choice and mirrors the `--validate-plans-strict` pattern shipped in Plan 3 F003 (commit c104c22). Auditor recommendation explicitly offers either path; choosing 'update the plan/tests/acceptance if the intended public flag is --architecture-drift-strict'. No code change required at close-out; acceptance items (1)-(6) are all satisfied by the as-shipped `--architecture-drift-strict` form. Full sweep: 2036 passed / 7 skipped under raw pytest (+25 new tests across F003+F005). Sanitization clean (1288 files). Operator-resolved as spec_ambiguity.
